title: Multiplicativity of the sign lift of an XOR-homomorphism
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a function that respects componentwise XOR, meaning $f(x \oplus y) = f(x) \oplus f(y)$ for all $x, y \in \{0,1\}^n$, and let $g : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be its $\pm 1$ lift, $g(x) = (-1)^{f(x)}$. Then $g$ turns XOR into multiplication:
\[
  g(x \oplus y) \;=\; g(x)\,g(y) \qquad \text{for all } x, y \in \{0,1\}^n.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f maps the Boolean hypercube to {0,1}
f is a homomorphism for componentwise XOR: f(x⊕y) = f(x)⊕f(y) for all x,y
g is the ±1 lift of f
replaced:
